title: Step-up secondary voltage
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the secondary voltage of the step-up transformer using the turns ratio and generator voltage.

title: Transmission line current
description: Important: Correctly calculates the current in the transmission line using the transmitted power and the step-up transformer's secondary voltage.

title: Transmission power loss
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the power loss on the transmission line using Joule's law (I²R).

title: Step-down turns ratio
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the turns ratio of the step-down transformer using the voltage at its primary coil and the output voltage.

title: User received power
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the power received by the user by subtracting the transmission line loss from the generator's output power.

title: Voltage drop calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the voltage drop on the transmission line (IR) to find the voltage at the step-down transformer's primary.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (e.g., kW, V, A, Ω) throughout the solution.

title: Incorrect power formula
description: Pitfall: Uses P = I²R or P = V²/R with the wrong voltage (e.g., generator voltage) to find transmission line current.

title: Sign/ratio reversal
description: Pitfall: Reverses the turns ratio (e.g., 1:10 instead of 10:1) for the step-down transformer or misapplies the voltage ratio formula.
